scope: Corollary 6.2 (Common Busemann pairs for a common label) of the manuscript “No bigeodesics in planar first-passage percolation” (preprints/No-bigeodesics-in-planar-first-passage-percolation-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 212 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f97d87dc82bcee0c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On one event of probability one, whenever two oriented bigeodesics p, q in any fixed chart have the same upper label, their two Busemann functions agree: (59) Bp+ = Bq+ , Bp− = Bq− . This assertion is simultaneous over the bigeodesics and their possibly random labels. It also holds almost surely in every environment whose law is absolutely continuous with respect to the iid law, and simultaneously for a countable collection of such environments.
